findings.ref: plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/check-task-state.sh and check-task-state.ps1, critical Done two-person enforcement
findings.note: Two-person enforcement derives criticality solely from the editable Risk line in tasks.md, unlike evidence verification which trusts the validated contract risk. A task whose contract remains critical can set tasks.md Risk to high and reach Done without a Second Approval. The tests cover high tasks and critical tasks separately but do not test this tasks/contract risk mismatch.

The policy requires SDD_EVIDENCE_SIGSTORE_VERIFIED to be truthy, but both implementations accept every non-empty value. Values such as "0" or "false" therefore approve an arbitrary sigstore signature value; the tests exercise only unset and "1" and miss this fail-open case.
